key.t3craft.attention_last: Back to the last opened thread
t3craft.attention.nobody: No thread is waiting for you.
t3craft.demo.button.tooltip: Open the T3Craft HQ demo world (superflat, creative). Created the first time; the HQ is built when you enter.
t3craft.demo.confirm.title: Open %s?
t3craft.demo.confirm.body: This world will be saved and closed, then the T3Craft HQ demo world opens.
t3craft.demo.reset.button.tooltip: Deletes the T3Craft HQ demo world and creates it fresh (zip backup in backups/ first, unless demo.resetBackup is false). Only works inside the HQ world or from the menu; never touches other worlds.
t3craft.demo.void.rescued: Back on solid ground: the void is not part of the HQ.
t3craft.demo.start.body: The HQ build starts when you walk or press
t3craft.demo.start.hint: The build will start when you walk or press [Start]
t3craft.demo.reset.title: Reset the T3Craft HQ world?
t3craft.demo.reset.body: Are you sure? Everything built in the HQ is lost.
t3craft.hqmenu.title: T3Craft HQ
t3craft.hqmenu.rebuild.title: Rebuild the HQ with %s?
t3craft.hqmenu.reset.tooltip: Backs up the HQ world as a zip in backups/, deletes it and builds it again with the chosen layout. Only the T3Craft HQ world; never any other world.
t3craft.hqmenu.packs.export.tooltip: Writes every layout's current materials and parameters to config/t3craft/hq-layouts/ (existing files are kept) so you can edit them. Edits apply without restarting.
t3craft.hqmenu.packs.reload.tooltip: Reads config/t3craft/hq-layouts/ again now (it is also watched every second); the built HQ changes as a diff.
t3craft.hqmenu.reset.body: A zip backup of %1$s is saved in backups/ first. Then only that world (saves/%2$s) is deleted and created again, and the HQ is built with %3$s. No other world is touched. Everything built in the HQ is lost.
t3craft.hqmenu.reset.body_nobackup: There is NO backup (demo.resetBackup is false). Only %1$s (saves/%2$s) is deleted and created again, and the HQ is built with %3$s. No other world is touched. Everything built in the HQ is lost.
t3craft.hqmenu.info.no_world: No HQ world yet: Open HQ creates it and builds %s.
t3craft.hqmenu.info.not_built: Nothing built yet: the next Open HQ builds %s.
advancements.t3craft.first_contact.title: First Contact
advancements.t3craft.first_contact.descr: Use a T3 Terminal to look in on your agents
t3craft.survival.needs_terminal: You need a T3 Terminal in your inventory (craft: glass pane + redstone + copper ingot)
t3craft.survival.spectator: Builders do not work in spectator mode
t3craft.survival.adventure: Builders cannot edit an adventure world without cheats
t3craft.survival.needs_cheats: Free debug builds need cheats or creative mode
t3craft.workstation.status: Workstation screens: %s (%s shown, %s archived). /t3craft workstation on|off
t3craft.schedule.waiting: Waiting for T3 to send the scheduled tasks…
t3craft.schedule.direct_only: Scheduled tasks are only shown in direct mode (pair with /t3craft pair).
t3craft.archive.catalog.no_env: No environment in direct mode (the archive needs a paired environment).
t3craft.archive.catalog.shell_only: Settled threads from the live shell only (archived and older reads are off).
t3craft.archive.recent: Archive: read less than 30 s ago, nothing to do.
t3craft.archive.status: Archive: %s closed threads, %s. Open it from %s.
t3craft.queue.title: Run queue
t3craft.queue.none: No queued runs in the working threads.
t3craft.queue.none_working: No thread is working right now, so nothing is queued.
t3craft.queue.cmd.no_run: No queued run %s in that thread (it may have started already)
t3craft.queue.result.failed: No answer, it may or may not have applied: %s
t3craft.survival.missing_materials_job: %s paused, missing materials: %s (builders take them from chests or barrels next to the site and from your inventory; the build resumes by itself)
t3craft.survival.build_cost: Survival: the builders will use %s, from chests or barrels next to the site and from your inventory
t3craft.operate.enable.tooltip: Enable control (operate) without losing the read-only pairing. Near-admin: it can start agents and approve commands on that host.
t3craft.operate.enable.title: Enable control (operate) for %s
t3craft.operate.enable.warning: Near-admin: with control, this Minecraft can start agents and approve commands on %s. Anyone who controls this PC controls that host. The read-only pairing is kept; revoke control any time.
t3craft.operate.enable.host: On the T3 host, issue a one-time credential (explicit scopes, never without --scope):
t3craft.operate.revoke.tooltip: Revoke control: deletes the local operate token. Back to read-only.
t3craft.operate.revoke.title: Revoke control for %s?
t3craft.operate.revoke.body: Deletes the local operate token: the environment stays paired, read-only. Also revoke the session on the host: t3 auth session list / t3 auth session revoke <id>.
t3craft.operate.confirm.title: Confirm: %s
t3craft.operate.confirm.warning: This is sent to T3 with control (operate) and cannot be undone from Minecraft.
t3craft.operate.launch.title: New thread
t3craft.operate.launch.summary: About to launch a new thread:
t3craft.operate.launch.summary.title: Title: %s
t3craft.operate.launch.summary.mode: Runs with approvals required, in the project checkout. Once T3 lists it, its NPC works at a desk in your HQ (build the HQ to see it).
t3craft.operate.launch.no_envs: No environment has control (operate) enabled. Enable it in Environments → Control…
t3craft.operate.launch.no_projects: No projects known for this environment (is it connected?).
t3craft.operate.snooze.title: Snooze %s until…
t3craft.podium.nobody: Nobody is waiting for you at this podium.
t3craft.blocks.status: Blocks module: %s (%s lamps loaded, %s changed last update). /t3craft blocks link <env:thread> | unlink
t3craft.blocks.singleplayer_only: Only in singleplayer or as LAN host.
t3craft.blocks.look_at_block: Look at a T3Craft monitor or lamp.
t3craft.chat.history.bridge: Bridge mode can't show chat history: the bridge doesn't serve it yet. Pair this environment and set "mode": "direct" in t3craft.json to read it here.
t3craft.chat.history.not_paired: Environment "%s" is not paired, so its chat history can't be read.
t3craft.chat.link.thread_missing_detail: %s is not in the loaded thread list.
t3craft.chat.compose.read_only: Read-only: enable control to send messages
t3craft.chat.compose.hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
t3craft.pair.title: Pair with T3
t3craft.pair.host: On the T3 host, issue a one-time credential (explicit scopes, never without --scope):
t3craft.pair.mode.tooltip: Read + control: watch and act on threads (send, approve, stop…). Read-only: only watch; you can enable control later from Environments.
t3craft.pair.warning.control: Control: this Minecraft can start agents and approve commands on that host. Destructive actions ask for confirmation and everything lands in audit.log.
t3craft.archive.screen.title: Archive
t3craft.archive.screen.no_match: No closed thread matches the search or filters.
t3craft.archive.hint.terminal: the archive terminal in the HQ or %s
t3craft.hq.layout.classic.name: Classic
t3craft.hq.layout.classic.desc: Hub, central spine and one wing per project (the original HQ).
t3craft.actions.register_project.title: Register project
t3craft.actions.field.name: Name (optional)
t3craft.hq.layout.hybrid-ringcampus.name: Ringed citadel
t3craft.hq.layout.hybrid-ringcampus.desc: A ringed citadel: a vaulted hub over a sunken patio, rings of barrios round their courtyards, special rooms on the nodes.
t3craft.merge.title: Pull requests waiting
t3craft.merge.no_link: T3 gave no link for this pull request: opens the chat.
